title: Request for Expungement

signers.label: Approving Judge
signers.note: Filled automatically at approval -- not part of the intake handoff flow.

notes: No source Google Doc -- built directly from Bar Procedures Section 2G. Capital crimes cannot be expunged (that requires a Pardon instead) -- worth a reminder in the bot's intake flow, though it isn't a field on the document itself. Waiting periods (14 days for misdemeanors/non-violent felonies, 30 days for violent felonies since the last conviction) are checked against conviction_date and date_filed.

fields.label: Applicant Discordia
fields.prompt: What Discord email/account do you have on file?

fields.label: CID
fields.prompt: Use /cid in city. This will add your CID to your clipboard. Paste that in here please.

fields.label: Lawyer
fields.prompt: Are you represented by a lawyer for this request? If so, name them (or answer "None").

fields.label: Charge(s) to Expunge
fields.prompt: Which specific charge(s)/conviction(s) are you requesting be expunged? (Note: capital crimes can't be expunged -- that requires a Pardon instead.)

fields.label: Date of Conviction
fields.prompt: What date were you convicted of the charge(s) you're requesting to expunge?

fields.label: Personal Statement
fields.prompt: Write a personal statement: why do you want this expunged, and what have you done to demonstrate a change in behavior since?

fields.label: Supporting References / Evidence of Reform
fields.prompt: List any references supporting your request (e.g. Police Officers, Doctors, Government Officials, Business Owners) or evidence of community service. (Answer "None" if you don't have any yet.)

fields.label: Weapons License Reinstatement Requested
fields.prompt: If this is approved, are you requesting your weapons license be reinstated? (You'll still need to see a Law Enforcement Officer in person to actually get it back.)

fields.label: Hearing Status
fields.note: The assigned judge decides whether a hearing is needed or the request can be processed offline -- not something the applicant chooses.

fields.label: Fee Assessed
fields.note: Set by the judge on approval -- ranges from $0 to $250,000 depending on the number and severity of charges expunged.

fields.label: Approving Judge
fields.note: Rendered in cursive. Filled in by the bot when a judge approves the expungement -- never asked of the applicant.
